orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Manoj Kumar Tiwari
orders.text:
CLMA No. 11900/2018 (Time Extension Application) 
In 
WPMS No. 1748 of 2017 
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. N.S. Pundir, Advocate for the petitioner. 
Mr. Sanjay Bhatt, Advocate for the 
respondent. 
The petitioner had filed this application 
seeking extension of time to comply the order dated 
20.07.2017, whereby this Court has directed the 
petitioner to deposit the amount of salary involved 
in the impugned order. The applicant annexes the 
copy of the draft drawn on Punjab National Bank 
being draft no. ULM 936880 for a sum of Rs. 
15,28,862/-. 
In these circumstances, the time extension 
application is allowed. 
The petitioner is directed to deposit the 
aforesaid draft in original, the copy of which is 
annexed with the time extension application, before 
the Registrar General of this Court within a period 
of three days from today. 
Subject to the above observations, the time 
extension application stands disposed of. 
The interim order already granted will 
continue to operate till the next date of listing. 
 
(Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.) 
 10.08.2018 
Pooja/Neha

CLMA No. 10011/2019 (Appl. for Withdrawal)
In 
WPMS No.1748 of 2017 
Hon’ble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
Mr. N.S. Pundir, Advocate for the 
petitioner. 
Mr. Lalit Miglani, Advocate, holding 
brief of Mr. Pankaj Miglani, Advocate for the 
respondent/applicant. 
Heard learned counsel for the parties. 
In view of the facts mentioned in the 
affidavit filed in support of withdrawal 
application, respondent is permitted to 
withdraw a sum of Rs. 6.00 lakh out of the 
amount deposited by the petitioner in terms 
of the order dated 20.07.2017. 
Registry is directed to release Rs. 6.00 
lakh in favour of the respondent/applicant, 
subject to final outcome of this writ petition. 
List this matter for hearing in the week 
commencing 26.08.2019. 
 (Manoj K. Tiwari, J.) 
Arpan 23.07.2019

orders.text:
(Substitution Appl. No.2829 of 2020)
In 
WPMS No.1748 of 2017
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
(via Video Conferencing)
Mr. N.S. Pundir, Advocate for the petitioner.
Mr. Pankaj Miglani, Advocate for the 
respondent. 
The counsel for the petitioner had filed a 
substitution application being Substitution 
Application No.2829 of 2020 seeking substitution of 
heirs of Mr. Usman Ali, who is reported to have died 
on 23.12.2019. 
Substitution application has been preferred 
within time, which is not being opposed by the 
counsel for the respondent. Hence, the same would 
stand allowed.
The petitioner would carry out the necessary 
substitution within the period of ten days from today.
The writ petition is directed to be listed on 
12.08.2020. 
Accordingly, the Urgency Application No.6711 
of 2020 would also stand disposed of. 
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.)
 29.07.2020
Arti
